snippet.title: inbento - PC/Xbox trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to Steam, itch.io and Xbox consoles on July 30th 2021!

Play with food, solve 120+ puzzle recipes and enjoy a cute story in this culinary brain-teaser from the creators of Golf Peaks!

More info: http://afterburn.games/inbento
and http://facebook.com/afterburngames
